related.title: Telstar 通訊衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付邊緣剖面、拖影預算與可辨識尺度，保留配準殘差。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver edge profiles, a smear budget, resolvable scale and registration residuals.
related.difference: 在共同可見時窗內排定資料轉送，區分接觸時間、有效酬載與傳播延遲。
related.differenceEn: Schedule relay inside a common visibility window while separating contact time, useful payload and propagation delay.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將地面移動距離除以 GSD，分別保留公尺與像元的中間結果。
手算有效秒數 550，依序換算 Mbit 與 MB，再填 80 MB 和 40 MB 的排程。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Divide ground displacement by GSD, retaining intermediate results in metres and pixels.
Compute 550 useful seconds, convert Mbit to MB and attempt an 80 MB plus 40 MB schedule.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Aqua 水循環觀測衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付邊緣剖面、拖影預算與可辨識尺度，保留配準殘差。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver edge profiles, a smear budget, resolvable scale and registration residuals.
related.difference: 將蒸發、降雨及水氣儲存變化組成區域水量帳，推定水平輸送的殘差。
related.differenceEn: Combine evaporation, precipitation and vapour storage change into a regional water ledger and infer transport as a residual.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將地面移動距離除以 GSD，分別保留公尺與像元的中間結果。
先求 dW/dt=3 mm/day，再帶入守恆式，反代檢查左右兩邊。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Divide ground displacement by GSD, retaining intermediate results in metres and pixels.
Compute dW/dt=3 mm/day, solve conservation and substitute back into both sides.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
